info.title: OnchainPulse API
info.description: Intelligence API for the onchain financial transition. Decodes legislation, tracks RWA tokenization, models sector scenarios, guides onchain integration, tracks crypto ETF flows and the CLARITY Act. All endpoints require x402 payment (USDC on Base mainnet) via the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

get.summary: Translate crypto bills to plain English with sector impact
get.description: Searches Congress.gov and real-time sources to translate any pending or enacted legislation into plain English with sector impact analysis and passage probability. Global: US, EU, UK, Singapore, UAE.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Bill name or topic (e.g. 'GENIUS Act', 'stablecoin regulation', 'MiCA')

get.summary: Survey the real-world-asset market across asset classes
get.description: Tracks the tokenized RWA market with live DefiLlama protocol data. Covers institutional moves by BlackRock, DTCC, JPMorgan, BNY Mellon, State Street, and others. Broad and cheap; for product-level depth see /api/rwa-yield (yield comparison), /api/rwa-risk (issuer/redemption risk), and /api/gold-check (tokenized gold).

parameters.name: asset_class
parameters.description: Specific asset class focus (e.g. 'US Treasuries', 'real estate', 'private credit')

get.summary: Compare tokenized treasury/MMF yields: BUIDL, USDY, OUSG
get.description: Compares tokenized-treasury and money-market-fund yields live-aggregated from DeFiLlama across every chain deployment of each product (min/max/TVL-weighted APY range, never a single stale figure), combined with spot-checked issuer, minimum-investment, and eligibility facts. No competitor sells this as a pay-per-call product (rwa.xyz is $500/mo, DeFiLlama Pro is $300/mo).

get.summary: Assess issuer and redemption risk for a named RWA product
get.description: Issuer/redemption risk read for a named tokenized RWA product: issuer entity and regulator, redemption mechanics, NAV publication method (issuer-marked vs independent oracle), attestation cadence, chain/bridge risk across multi-chain deployments, and a Goldfinch-style honesty note contrasting stated aggregate loss rates against real depositor outcomes for opaque-NAV/private-credit-style products. Core facts come from a spot-checked static issuer profile, not LLM memory; Tavily supplies recent developments only.

get.summary: Compare tokenized gold products: PAXG vs XAUT
get.description: Compares tokenized gold products on live market cap and price vs. a live spot-gold reference (signed premium/discount, honestly labeled if derived from a fallback), attestation freshness (KPMG monthly for PAXG since 2026-02-28, vs BDO Italia quarterly ISAE 3000 for XAUT), and vault/custody facts.

get.summary: Model sector impact scenarios with if/then analysis
get.description: Models the structural sector impact of regulatory developments or institutional events. No investment advice. Describes entity types and business models that are advantaged or face headwinds.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: The development to model (e.g. 'GENIUS Act passes', 'DTCC full tokenization launch', 'MiCA enforcement begins')

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Sector to focus on, or 'all' for comprehensive coverage

get.summary: Guide practical onchain onboarding by organization type
get.description: Step-by-step practical guidance for entering the onchain economy. Covers individuals (self-custody, stablecoins), businesses (payments, treasury), developers (Base/Ethereum), and payment integration.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Additional context about the user's situation

200.description: Transition guide with steps, tools, and jurisdiction notes

get.summary: Monitor institutional onchain activity, weekly briefs
get.description: Synthesizes recent institutional onchain developments: tokenization launches, regulatory updates, infrastructure milestones, product announcements from major banks, asset managers, and exchanges.

get.summary: Map regulatory compliance duties by jurisdiction
get.description: Provides regulatory framework intelligence for crypto, stablecoin, and tokenized asset activities by jurisdiction. Covers MiCA (EU), GENIUS Act (US), FCA registration (UK), MAS PSA (Singapore), VARA (UAE). Educational intelligence, not legal advice.

parameters.name: use_case
parameters.description: What the entity wants to do (e.g. 'issue a stablecoin', 'operate a crypto exchange', 'accept USDC payments')

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Specific framework to focus on (e.g. 'MiCA', 'GENIUS Act')

get.summary: Explain how to tokenize any asset type, step by step
get.description: Explains how tokenization works for specific asset types. Covers process, legal structure, platforms, honest costs, and liquidity reality for real estate, equities, bonds, funds, commodities, and more.

parameters.name: asset_type
parameters.description: Asset type to analyze (e.g. 'real estate', 'equity', 'bond', 'private credit', 'art')

get.summary: Compare tokenized yields with live risk-adjusted rates
get.description: Analyzes the tokenized yield landscape using live DefiLlama data. Covers tokenized T-bills (BUIDL, BENJI, ONDO, USDY), stablecoin yields (Aave, Compound), and money market funds. Risk-adjusted comparison.

get.summary: Track US spot crypto ETF flows with per-issuer detail
get.description: Daily/weekly net flows for US spot BTC, ETH, and SOL ETFs: live per-issuer breakdown (IBIT, FBTC, ARKB, ETHA, and more — AUM, fees, daily/cumulative flow), deterministic streak and accelerating/decelerating trend classification, and a cross-asset rotation read. Source: SoSoValue's live feed (Farside is Cloudflare-gated to non-browser fetches).

get.summary: Track CLARITY Act status, CFTC/SEC split, passage odds
get.description: US crypto market-structure legislation tracker: live CLARITY Act (H.R.3633) status and dated milestone history straight from congress.gov, what the bill actually changes (CFTC/SEC jurisdiction, digital-commodity definition), GENIUS Act stablecoin interplay, and a live Polymarket passage-odds read. Deterministic facts kept separate from synthesized outlook.

get.summary: Decode any onchain finance or regulatory term plainly
get.description: Translates any financial, regulatory, or technical term related to blockchain, tokenization, and onchain finance into plain English. Includes analogy, concrete 2026 example, common misconception, and depth levels for beginner/intermediate/advanced.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Term to explain (e.g. 'atomic settlement', 'MiCA', 'CASP', 'yield bearing stablecoin', 'RWA')

get.summary: Summarize the onchain transition in a weekly macro brief
get.description: Comprehensive macro brief on where traditional finance is in its onchain journey. Scores infrastructure, regulation, institutional adoption, and retail access. Regional breakdown for US, EU, Asia, and emerging markets.

200.description: State of the transition macro brief

get.summary: Scan a Solana memecoin pre-trade, deterministic verdict

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: x402 payment signature. OPTIONAL on the first request: call without it to receive HTTP 402 with payment terms, then retry with this header set. Strict clients must not require it up front.

200.description: Deterministic CLEAR/CAUTION/AVOID verdict + is_safe + risk_score, with safety (mint/freeze authority, LP lock, rug score, danger risks), holder concentration, and live momentum (liquidity, buy/sell flow, age). Fuses RugCheck + Solana RPC + DexScreener.

get.x-agent-use-case: An autonomous Solana trading agent calls this before buying any memecoin to get an instant rug/honeypot + momentum read as one decisive verdict.

get.summary: Scan an EVM token pre-trade, multi-chain, deterministic

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: x402 payment signature. OPTIONAL on the first request: call without it to receive HTTP 402 with payment terms, then retry with this header set. Strict clients must not require it up front.

200.description: Deterministic CLEAR/CAUTION/AVOID verdict + is_safe + risk_score, with safety (honeypot/sell-sim, buy/sell tax, open-source, proxy, mint, ownership renounced, pausable, blacklist, LP lock/burn — owner-gated risks marked dormant when renounced), holder concentration, and live momentum. Fuses GoPlus Token Security + DexScreener.

get.x-agent-use-case: An autonomous Base/EVM trading agent calls this before buying any token to get an instant honeypot/rug + momentum read as one decisive verdict, across 7 EVM chains.

x402.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402.description: x402 payment signature. USDC on Base mainnet. See /.well-known/agent.json for payment details.
